RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: Unknown; the information given cannot support a meaningful 0–100 estimate.

An all-woman panel is not, by itself, evidence of sex discrimination. Your qualifications warrant asking how the decision was reached, but the announcement may omit relevant experience, and leadership or consultation skills may have carried significant weight.

Follow up in writing. Request the selection criteria, their weighting, your assessment scores and feedback, and the expected response timeframe. Check whether your professional licence was required or merely preferred.

Raise sex discrimination if concrete evidence emerges—for example, sex-related remarks or inconsistent treatment—not simply because of the panel’s composition. If you’re considering a formal challenge, check local deadlines promptly; waiting for feedback may not extend them.
